title: Chapter 220: Curse Lifted
content:
Chapter 220: Curse Lifted

Hearing this, the old man was slightly stunned and felt relieved.

Although I don’t know how capable the person in front of me is, since I am so confident, it means that there is still a great chance of success.

As long as they succeed, their Xiao clan is willing to give everything.

As for this broken stone, whoever wants it.

This is what the old man thought in his heart, and it is also what the other Xiao tribe present thinks.

They want it, just freedom.

Although they know that the stone is extraordinary, if they still can't bear to leave the stone at this time, then they are really fools.

At this time, Lu Daosheng had already taken out a jade bottle, and the light purple air floated at the mouth of the bottle, which was obviously auspicious thing.

Buzz —

Suddenly, a powerful suction force surged from the mouth of the bottle.

The whole space began to shake violently.

As can be seen from the naked eye, the spots on the Bu Tian Stone began to slowly dissipate.

When the Xiao tribe around him saw this scene, he was extremely surprised.

"It's scattered, it's really scattered!"

"Hahaha, we're finally going to be free!"

At this moment, everyone could even feel the strange aura in their bodies gradually dissipating as the stains on the Bu Tian Stone faded.

At the same time, as time passed, several wisps of black gas overflowed from the Butian Stone and were sucked into the jade bottle in Lu Daosheng's hand.

"That should be the source of the curse."

A powerful man from Xiao clan said with a serious expression.

Everyone around nodded in agreement.

Finally, the Butian Stone restored its original luster, and a holy light shone out from the Butian Stone, and then flashed away.

Lu Daosheng did not hesitate at all. After taking the jade bottle, he waved his sleeves and put the Bu Tian Stone in front of him into his pocket.

The scene was a little quieter.

Then it suddenly broke out.

The Xiao clan members roared to the sky and roared.

The crazy outbreak of unwillingness and anger for millions of years, today, I finally felt freedom again.

"I, can we really go out?"

Although I had known the answer, someone asked in an excited and trembling tone.

"Yes, of course!"

Everyone was excited and burst into tears.

In the corner, Xiao Sheng also wiped his tears secretly, and at this moment, he was also very happy.

The Xiao clan is saved.

It’s a pity that he probably couldn’t see the day when the Xiao clan would be glorious again.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly appeared beside Xiao Sheng.

"For the sake of walking with you, I'll give you a chance."

A green fruit appeared in Lu Daosheng's hand and then threw it directly to Xiao Sheng.

After taking the fruit, Xiao Sheng was slightly stunned.

"This, is this the immortal fruit of immortality?!"

Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "You are pretty good at it."

"Life well."

After leaving this sentence, Lu Daosheng turned around and left.

Xiao Sheng choked up and then knelt down directly in the direction of Lu Daosheng.

"Thank you, fellow Taoist."

At this time, Xiao Mo appeared beside Xiao Sheng.

Looking at Lu Daosheng's back, Xiao Mo's expression was complicated.

"This person is really a great man."

Immediately, Xiao Mo looked at Xiao Sheng again, "Brother Xiao Sheng, what are you going to do next?"

With this immortal fruit, Xiao Sheng’s life span is temporarily worry-free.

Hearing this, Xiao Sheng slowly stood up, pondered for a moment, and said, "I plan to stay here."

"Stay here?"

Xiao Mo was a little surprised by this answer.

Because in his mind, the idea of staying in the ancestral land is wrong.

After all, the dreams of these Xiao seniors in the ancestral land have been that they can leave the ancestral land in time.

Now that Xiao Sheng wanted to stay in the ancestral land, Xiao Mo was a little unresponsive.

"Now, the Xiao clan no longer needs me so much. Since that's the case, I will stay in my ancestral land and be a graveswalker."

Xiao Sheng smiled slightly and directly expressed the rest of his life.

The ancestral land is full of the cemeteries of the predecessors of the Xiao clan.

I still need to find someone to take care of.

In the past, the ancestral land was the least short of people. Now, it is estimated that no one will dare to come to the ancestral land for a while.

"Oh well."

Finally, Xiao Mo nodded and agreed.

"Dad, should we leave?"

Lu Xue walked to Lu Daosheng and said carefully.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng asked back, "Don't you want to go back?"

go back?

Lu Xue lowered her head and did not answer.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng sighed, "It's really a big girl who is not a big one."

"Let's do this, there is an academy in the fairyland. How about sending you there to study?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue's expression lit up slightly.

"Okay, I love studying the most."

Anyway, it's enough to be outside. She has been staying in Huangcheng for a long time.

"Okay, after this matter is over, I'll send it to you."

"Uh-huh."

Immediately, the two of them walked towards the bottom of the mountain together.

And at this moment, a roar suddenly sounded from the depths of the ancestral land.

Immediately afterwards, a terrifying aura rushed towards everyone.

Feeling this aura, several seniors of Xiao clan were immediately ecstatic.

"It's Mr. Yu, he, senior is still here!"

When most of the people present were confused when they heard the word Yu Laoer.

Only a few old monsters from the Xiao clan knew this name.

Xiao Yu, that is already a person from several eras.

Buzz —

I saw that the space in the distance suddenly cracked, and the next moment, an old man covered in rags slowly walked out of the crack in the space. ,

You should know that because of the Heavenly Stone, the space here has become several stable, and even the strong people in the Immortal Emperor Realm cannot easily break it.

But the old man in front of him forced the space to open up.

When they saw the old man, several old monsters of Xiao clan immediately took the lead in saluting the old man.

"My younger generation, I've seen Mr. Yu."

Seeing this, the rest of the people hurriedly bowed.

"Curse, lifted?"

Xiao Yu's eyes were turbid. Although he was a little confused when he looked at the scene around him, he still asked.

Upon hearing this, a powerful Xiao clan immediately said, "Old Yu, it has been lifted, we can go out."

Hearing this, Xiao Yu just smiled slightly, his face looking extremely stiff.

"Just lift it."

At this moment, he was happy.

Because he didn't want something wrong with the Xiao clan outside.

At this time, Xiao Yu suddenly looked at Lu Daosheng in the distance.

The next moment, his body trembled and appeared directly in front of Lu Daosheng.

"What's up?"

Lu Daosheng said with a smile.

Looking at Lu Daosheng in front of him, Xiao Yu said, "You should be the one who helps me, Xiao clan, lift the curse."

Lu Daosheng did not deny it and nodded.

"That stone was also in your hands?"

Lu Daosheng still nodded.

Seeing this scene, the people of the Xiao clan around him suddenly became a little nervous.

Because Lu Daosheng is not simple.

And Mr. Yu is not simple either. It is rumored that his realm has reached the Immortal Emperor Realm.

They don’t even have the concept of that kind of strong man.

The two won't fight, right?

Xiao Yu looked at Lu Daosheng for a long time and then said, "On behalf of the Xiao clan, thank you for yourselves."

Even he could do nothing about that curse.

Although he didn't care about the curse, after all, millions of years are not long for him, but he would have to go out one day.

Now that Lu Daosheng has solved the problem, he naturally won’t do anything to Lu Daosheng.

The only regret is that stone.

Thinking of the stone, Xiao Yu felt helpless.

Are you not worthy of it?

Seeing this, the other Xiao people breathed a sigh of relief.

If these two fight, they dare not imagine the consequences.

At this time, Lu Daosheng did not stop and had already left with Lu Xue.

"Old Yu, are you going back to Xiao Clan together?"

A powerful man from Xiao asked.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Yu shook his head slightly.

"I still have to go into seclusion. If it weren't for the great noise here, I wouldn't have woken up."

After saying that, Xiao Yu turned around and headed towards the depths of the ancestral land.

The strong man from Xiao was a little confused, but he had no choice but to do anything about it.

As for the other powerful people of the Xiao clan in the ancestral land, they finally began to embark on the road to return home.

Although after tens of millions of years of accumulation, there were not many people in the Xiao tribe in the ancestral land, because some of them were like Xiao Sheng, who had little lifespan, so they chose to enter the ancestral land.

There are very few strong people like Xiao Mo who want to investigate the ancestral land problem clearly.

So now, there are only thirty or forty strong people.
